payload.reason: The evidence provides specific measures and methods used to evaluate the quality of a Q&A platform, particularly Zhihu Live, including data-driven approaches and statistical analysis of user reviews.

claims.text: A data-driven approach is used to evaluate the quality of the Zhihu Live platform, involving data collection, cleaning, normalization, and analysis.
Quality evaluation includes statistical measures such as mean, variance, and review counts to assess the reliability of review scores.
The dataset ZhihuLive-DB is utilized for quality evaluation, containing extensive records and comments for analysis.
Challenges in quality evaluation include the lack of a unique standard and the influence of review counts on perceived quality.
